method: Each Pashto form was copied from a professionally translated source, mostly with the English original side by side. Terms marked '(image)' come from the image-only Pashto PDF of IOM's Canadian Orientation Abroad workbook and were transcribed visually. PDF text extraction reverses the lam-alef ligature (e.g. 'الرې' for 'لارې'); quotes from the UK handbook and Doctors of the World PDFs were corrected for that only. A native Afghan Pashto speaker should review before publication.
